sentences: Low 4 high 5 hai, mid 4 aata hai, phir low ko 4 se 5 ban jana chahiye.
Jab a[mid] < x true hota hai to low = mid se low aage badh jayega.
Loop ka condition low < high check karta hai, low 5 ho gaya to loop band.
Mid calculate hota hai (4+5)/2 = 4, phir low update hoke 5 ho jayega.
a[4] < x diya hai isliye if wala part chalega aur low 5 ho jayega.
